newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares strengthen, aided by dollar.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares strengthen, aided by dollar.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended higher in line with international markets, aided by a stronger dollar and foreign investor buying, dealers said. They said transactions in pulp group Portucel, bank Banco Comercial Portugues, cement group Cimpor, electrical engineeering firm Efacec and Portugal Telecom, accounted for 54 percent of the total turnover of 9.1 billion escudos. Dealers said that if Wall Street closes higher and the dollar retains its strength, Lisbon bourse could rise again tomorrow. "If the Dow and the dollar behave themselves, Lisbon stocks have room to rise a little further," said one dealer.
